 HOLA! Fronterror, FAFSA & Halloween Fun 
 From Fronterror Film Festival highlights to Harmony School’s FAFSA push, plus Halloween deals and our HOLA Halloween Films Watchlist 
 By HOLA! Staff Published : Oct. 27, 2026 at 2:05 PM CDT | Updated : 17 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google LAREDO, Tex. (Hola Laredo) - 
 This episode of HOLA! starts with a recap of the Fronterror Film Festival, a look into Harmony School of Excellence’s FAFSA preparations, Halloween Deals at Charlie Clark Hyundai & Rudy’s Mattress and Sofa, and ends with a fun discussion of HOLA’s Halloween Films Watchlist.
